Notes are generated from the actual sound of your track
Keys: D F J K or Q W E R · Touch: tap the lanes · Esc pauses
Lanes follow the music: bass → lane 1, low-mids → lane 2, mids → lane 3, highs/hats → lane 4.
Hold notes: press the lane and keep holding until the tail ends. Quiet sounds: higher = fainter sounds make notes (applies on restart).
Tip: you can also drag & drop an audio file onto the page. If hits feel early/late, tweak Audio offset.
